steps.content:
Evening
7:15 PM
Central Gallery

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Corridor all clear, over.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Main hall all clear, over.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Back area all clear, over.

In preparation for the upcoming exhibition of famous paintings, the Central Gallery has mobilized over eighty percent of its own staff and coordinated with the Public Security Bureau to maintain order and protect the works.
Magnetic shielding is in place on all equipment, with select areas reinforced by tactical arms.
The space around the Otherland Angels has been emptied of all other art. The stage is set, every precaution taken against the phantom thieves—who are not just expected, but awaited.
Uniformed patrols walk the halls, while plainclothes operatives watch silently from within the crowd.

steps.speaker: Curator
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName}, will this be enough to take on Cat's Eye?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I wish I could guarantee that.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Cat's Eye is exceptionally skilled. I trust my team completely, but... there are always variables.
A long line of people has already wound its way outside the entrance. It's no wonder; the Central Gallery only displays certified, priceless masterpieces.
Topping the social feeds is the Otherland Angels. Visitors don't just want to see it. They need that selfie for the grid.
And then there's the real draw: the slim chance of witnessing the phantom thief group, Cat's Eye, pull off the heist live. Catching that on video would make anyone Eastside's overnight sensation.
No surprise, then, that the crowd keeps growing...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So many people...
So many people...!!
Amid the crowd, a small head pops up, glancing around.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Rui, Hitomi, do we need to adjust the plan?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: No. If anything, this crowd is perfect cover.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: There are at least ten officers at the exits, with many more mingling in the crowd.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: So… it seems we really have to pull back from the rooftop, like I said?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: We are. We're counting on you, Ai.
Kisugi Ai shades her eyes with one hand, looking up at the Central Gallery building.
It isn't especially tall, but the surrounding high-rises create a jagged skyline. If one has the skill... and the nerve...
Those roofs could become a road. An escape is within reach.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Hehe, leave it to me!
7:25 PM. The exhibition's opening draws ever closer.
Animated discussions ripple through the crowd while inside the venue, the final checks are made in quiet focus.

steps.speaker: Curator
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName}, please... You have to stop Cat's Eye.
Clutched in the curator's hand is a small card, which reads:
"Ten minutes after the exhibition opens tonight, we will take the Otherland Angels."

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We'll do everything we can. That's a promise.
Inside the Central Gallery, an antique clock ticks with a dull, heavy rhythm. It's 7:30 PM.
The doors swing wide, and the visitors surge forward in a single, restless tide.
They stream past the other halls—ignoring paintings, sculptures, photographs—all driven toward the Otherland Angels.
The venue hums with a deafening din. Faces glisten, chests tighten, yet the mass pushes relentlessly onward.
Five minutes in, the crowd has only thickened.
The curator's handkerchief dabs at a cold sweat.
At eight minutes, every guard's fingers tense around their weapon.
As the second hand nears its mark, the crowd's noise seems to dissolve, leaving only the clock's steady beat and the anxious thud of their own hearts.
Time's up. Ready?
Bong... Bong...
The clock's chimes lock the crowd in place. Every head tilts upward, every gaze drawn to the sound. For a breath, memory itself seems suspended—what were they doing? What were they thinking?
After the last, echoing note fades, a woman's voice erupts from the mass of people. It's sudden, clear, and startling as cold water hitting a sizzling surface.
Failure is not an option. Let's move!
The crowd surges into chaos—then, with a snap, the hall is swallowed by darkness.
Suddenly, screams and cries for help ring out as the crowd scrambles to escape. But before anyone realizes it, every door to the Otherland Angels exhibition hall is sealed shut!
But Kisugi Hitomi's mind locks onto the clues: the worn scuffs on the ceramic floor, the heavy, deliberate placement of the guards. Her instincts ring loud and clear.
What's going on?!
Through the earpiece, in that precise moment, comes the telltale static, then dead silence. The guard room's channels have just been severed from outside control.
There is no mistaking it. The Chief of Minos has sealed this building.
Kisugi Hitomi steels her resolve—
Rui... Ai... I'll complete the mission as planned.
Without hesitation, Kisugi Hitomi pulls back and moves for the guard room supply depot. Her older sister's hidden weapon is waiting there.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: ...Ai?! Can you hear me?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Hitomi! Your signal's back?! Rui! I've got Hitomi!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: What happened?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Just a while ago, your signal flickered and vanished right next to the Otherland Angels. Comms went dead. You scared the life out of us.
Through her communicator, Hitomi hears her sisters breathe a collective sigh of relief.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: So what's really going on here?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: It's weird, Hitomi! I only cut the power lines; I didn't do anything else!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: You seemed to have teleported right out of the exhibition hall.
This is... unprecedented. Hitomi struggles to process it.
But the faces around her haven't changed. They're the same crowd from before the blackout. If she really had been teleported, wouldn't that mean all these people were moved along with her?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: No… this doesn't make any sense!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Hitomi, calm down. Describe what you've seen so far.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: I followed the plan—28 steps east through the crowd. But... the fire escape was gone. Just a wall.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: It was too dark to be sure of anything. After all...
Her earpiece erupts with a sudden burst of static, as if another signal is cutting into the channel.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Attention, all guests: for your safety, access to the Otherland Angels exhibition is temporarily suspended due to crowd conditions. Please remain calm and follow the illuminated floor guides to the nearest exit immediately. Thank you for your cooperation.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You have been transferred to a secure hall. Please proceed forward in an orderly manner to safety.
As her vision adjusts to the darkness, Kisugi Hitomi takes in the space. She's definitely two exhibition halls away from the painting.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you choose not to comply... please understand the gallery will activate necessary security measures.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Let's grab the painting and get out of here, quick.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Looks like they've gotten their eyes on us.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: In that case, there's no more need to hide, right, Rui?
